component.name: HomePage2

Label.text: Select a game using the remote

component.script:
function init() m.top.setFocus(true) m.title = m.top.findNode("title") m.btnTic = m.top.findNode("btnTic") m.btnCheckers = m.top.findNode("btnCheckers") m.btnTicBg = m.top.findNode("btnTicBg") m.btnCheckersBg = m.top.findNode("btnCheckersBg") m.Stext = m.top.findNode("Stext")
' Font sizes m.title.font.size = 88 m.Stext.font.size = 28
' Set up focus observers m.btnTic.observeField("focusedChild", "onButtonFocusChange") m.btnCheckers.observeField("focusedChild", "onButtonFocusChange")
' Set initial focus m.btnTic.setFocus(true) updateButtonStyles() end function
function onButtonFocusChange() updateButtonStyles() end function
function updateButtonStyles() ' Both buttons start at medium grey (0x999999FF) ' Focused button becomes light grey (0xDDDDDDFF) if m.btnTic.hasFocus() then m.btnTicBg.color = "0xDDDDDDFF" ' Light grey for focused m.btnCheckersBg.color = "0x999999FF" ' Medium grey for unfocused else if m.btnCheckers.hasFocus() then m.btnTicBg.color = "0x999999FF" ' Medium grey for unfocused m.btnCheckersBg.color = "0xDDDDDDFF" ' Light grey for focused end if end function
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false
if key = "OK" then if m.btnTic.hasFocus() then print "Tic-Tac-Toe selected" launchGame("TicTacToeScene") return true else if m.btnCheckers.hasFocus() then print "Checkers selected" launchGame("CheckersScene") return true end if end if return false end function
function launchGame(sceneName as String) ' Create the game scene gameScene = CreateObject("roSGNode", sceneName)
' Observe when user wants to return to home gameScene.observeField("exitGame", "onGameExit")
' Show the game scene m.top.getParent().appendChild(gameScene) gameScene.setFocus(true)
' Store reference m.currentGame = gameScene end function
function onGameExit() ' Remove game scene and return focus if m.currentGame <> invalid then m.top.getParent().removeChild(m.currentGame) m.currentGame = invalid m.btnTic.setFocus(true) end if end function
